exercises.title: Review tips 1 — review challenges and remedies
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers lists challenges for requirements reviews: large requirements documents, large inspection teams, geographically separated reviewers and unprepared reviewers. Tips include: review early and incrementally, use checklists, give each reviewer a perspective, focus on high-risk parts, and keep the team small.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Wiegers nêu các thách thức: tài liệu lớn, nhóm inspection đông, người review ở xa nhau, người review không chuẩn bị. Mẹo: review sớm và từng phần, dùng checklist, mỗi người một góc nhìn, tập trung phần rủi ro cao, giữ nhóm nhỏ.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Review tips 1 — review challenges and remedies — answer key

1. The SRS is 300 pages. Best approach?SRS dày 300 trang. Cách tốt nhất?
   Answer: a) Review it incrementally as sections are written, focusing on high-risk parts
   Small chunks, early, risk-based.VI: Từng phần nhỏ, sớm, theo rủi ro.

2. 15 stakeholders want to attend the inspection. What do you do?15 bên liên quan muốn dự inspection. Làm gì?
   Answer: d) Keep the meeting small; pick representatives of each perspective; let others review offline
   Large teams slow decisions; choose perspectives.VI: Nhóm đông chậm quyết định; chọn đại diện góc nhìn.

3. Several inspectors arrive without having read the document. What does the moderator do?Vài inspector tới mà chưa đọc tài liệu. Moderator làm gì?
   Answer: a) Reschedule; preparation is essential
   Most defects are found during preparation.VI: Phần lớn lỗi được tìm ra lúc chuẩn bị.

4. Reviewers are in Hanoi, HCMC and Tokyo. Wiegers suggests…Người review ở Hà Nội, TP.HCM và Tokyo. Wiegers gợi ý…
   Answer: a) collaborative review tools and asynchronous comments, with a short online meeting for disputed issues
   Use tools and asynchronous review.VI: Dùng công cụ và review bất đồng bộ.

exercises.title: Review tips 2 — perspectives
exercises.problemHtml:
Giving each reviewer a perspective finds more defects: a user checks that tasks are possible; a developer checks that requirements can be designed and built; a tester checks that each requirement is verifiable; a maintainer checks clarity and modifiability. Which perspective is most likely to raise each comment?

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Giao cho mỗi người review một góc nhìn giúp tìm nhiều lỗi hơn. Góc nhìn nào dễ nêu từng nhận xét nhất?

exercises.title: Review tips 3 — inspect an SRS excerpt
exercises.problemHtml:
Excerpt from the SRS of PetCare, a veterinary-clinic booking app. Inspect each line with the checklist and record the main defect type. Some lines are fine — mark them No defect (a false claim costs as much as a miss).

  • L1 The system shall let a pet owner book a check-up for a registered pet.
  • L2 The system shall send reminders in a timely manner.
  • L3 A booking shall be cancelled up to 2 hours before the appointment. (Elsewhere, FR-40: up to 24 hours.)
  • L4 The system shall let a vet record a diagnosis for
  • L5 The system shall respond to every request within 0.001 ms on 3G.
  • L6 The system shall show the vet’s schedule for the next 14 days.
  • L7 The system shall store pet photos in an S3 bucket using the AWS SDK v3.
  • L8 The system shall generate a monthly revenue report for the clinic owner.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Trích SRS của PetCare (đặt lịch phòng khám thú y). Soát từng dòng theo checklist, ghi loại lỗi chính. Dòng không lỗi ⇒ No defect.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Review tips 4 — informal or formal review?
exercises.problemHtml:
Informal reviews (peer desk-check, pass-around, walkthrough) are quick and cheap; the inspection is the most formal, with roles, entry/exit criteria and recorded data, and finds the most defects. Choose the more suitable review for each situation.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Review không chính thức nhanh, rẻ; inspection chính thức nhất, tìm nhiều lỗi nhất. Chọn loại phù hợp.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.
